description_en: Queries the route policies of the VPC firewall for a transit router
description_zh: 获取TR防火墙路由策略列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-tr-firewall-v2-route-policy-list --lang zh --firewall-id vfw-tr-d5ba592ac6c84aff0000 --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --policy-id policy-7b66257c14e141fb0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTrFirewallV2RoutePolicyList

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC firewall for a transit router. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the ErrorParameters (400) error is returned. You can call the DescribeTrFirewallsV2List operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: VPC 边界防火墙实例 ID。本参数必填，缺失时返回 ErrorParameters（400）；可先调用 DescribeTrFirewallsV2List 获取
parameters.name: firewall_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to display per page for paging in a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number for paging in a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route policy
parameters.name: policy_id

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

TrFirewallRoutePolicies.description_en: The route policies of the VPC firewall for a transit router

items.description_en: The route policy of the VPC firewall for a transit router

策略状态。取值：

creating：创建中

closing：关闭中

PolicyType.description_en:
The traffic redirection scenario type of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls at the border for a transit router in Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) Enterprise Edition. Valid values:
fullmesh: Full mesh.
one_to_one: Point-to-point.
end_to_end: Point-to-multipoint
PolicyType.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙云企业网企业版引流场景类型。取值：

fullmesh：多点间互联

one_to_one：点到点

end_to_end：点到多点
